vision.name: Saiyan Tactics
vision.text:
ENDURANCE 3.
(Villains only. Limit 2 per deck. You may not search for Saiyan Tactics with this card's effect.)
POWER: If the highest power level of your MP's Level 4 is 500,000 or less, search your Banished Zone for 2 Styled Setups and Rejuvenate them. If your opponent's MP has lost stages from one of your effects this combat, you may place one of them into play instead.
(Banish after use.)
